notes.title: Hello scouts! Here's the first bigger patch post-console launch, adding some safety measures and fixes.

items.text: Since a lot of you have been asking about the game's file size, here's an explanation for those of you who missed the 3.0 patch notes.

With the crossplay update, we added 208 maps to the game's map rotation. Previously, we've been patching in maps every two to three weeks for the game, but with console launches and patches slowing down, this will no longer be possible.

Instead, we added a set number of maps that the game will cycle through forever. This ensures that crossplay works correctly and that you have much more replayability! We get that the increase surprised some players, but we hope you understand our reasons for the sudden jump.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/68a1cdf48ec9cbfb5b0ea76cc13cafae58c1c2e7.gif"]
Made room codes slightly longer so there are way more combinations now for safety
Sprint and Climb inputs are now held actions on controller, matching the way it works on keyboard & mouse.
In the settings, there is now a way to switch between Hold and Toggle for the Sprint and Climb inputs.
Fixed an issue where toggling climb on controller did not allow you to release the toggle with the same button.
The settings menu now displays slider-based settings without decimals, and converts them to percentages where it makes sense.
Scouts should be able to walk onto each other’s heads again
Added protections against several common griefing methods
We are still looking into other bugs and issues! Please keep reporting them with as much detail as possible to support@landfall.se so we can have a look.
HOTFIX PATCH!
Room codes for joining games in other regions should now be fixed

You may have noticed this last week's maps have been weirdly consistent in terms of biome selection, with each day being either all old or all new maps. This patch will replace the current map pool with islands that are properly randomized.
Campfire saves should now properly track the state of the luggage and other objects around the campfire in the Citadel

Made non-host game saves a little more consistent (players that aren't the host don't get complete world state in their game saves like the host does. When players other than the original Host decide to host a run from a save, they will still see a little weirdness around item spawning, sorry!)

Fixed bug where the host's run-based achievement progress wouldn't save at a campfire (this affected things like the Gourmand badge; the game would forget what items the host had already eaten when Continuing a run from a save)
Players reconnecting to a game after Continuing from a save should *also* not spawn dead when they should be alive
Fixed a case where the Bugle of Friendship would magically recharge
Fixed some more cases where trying to join a game with a bad room code would cause the game to get stuck at a loading screen
Maybe made reviving less buggy who knows though tbh

When we started integrating the changes necessary to support PEAK on consoles, we created a lot of bugs having to do with how player and world state are saved. If you've been on PEAK in the last few weeks and have needed to reconnect to an ongoing game or save and come back later, you've probably seen some of these issues pop up in the form of coming back dead, losing items you had, etc. We're really sorry about that, and thanks for sticking with us as we track them all down! We've been working really hard to fix those bugs, and hopefully this patch sees most of the remaining cases solved, but as always, please let us know through our Bug Reporting channel on the PEAK Discord if you have more problems (BE NICE THO!!!)
Bug Fixes
Reconnecting players will no longer come back dead in cases where they should still be alive
Fixed bug where players loading a save from the Citadel campfire could not earn the Medieval History badge
Cloned items with fuel should no longer spontaneously recharge
Fixed some visual artifacts with the lava streams in the Kiln
Optimized several meshes in the final biome
Players attempting to connect to a game in a different part of the world will no longer get stuck on the Loading screen
Fixed a case where attempting to join a room code that doesn't exist would break your menu buttons
Fixed an issue where reconnecting or loading a save as a skeleton would sometimes instantly kill you
Misc.
Reduced the amount of fall damage a player takes when leaving an anti-sphere
Restored original menu music

notes.title: Hello Scouts! Here’s a new patch for you ːPEAKsaluteː

items.text: In the previous build, we had some issues with the Bookworm badge where the progress would be reset at the start of every run, and the Guidebook Scrolls would disappear when opened. This led to some people losing their badges and prevented others from achieving it. Super sorry about that!

To make this right, we’ve added a temporary fix so those of you who earned the badge can get it without having to redo it. Flip the guidebook to the second page (the one with the Scoutmaster and Rule 0 on it) and use the salute emote - this should grant you the badge. This is a CHEAT that will work for everyone, so only use it if you already earned the badge!!!
Amulets can no longer be cooked.
Fixed an issue where the Bookworm Badge would reset its progress at the start of every run
Guidebook scrolls should no longer disappear when opened
Fixed a case where longer runs would suddenly start lagging out of nowhere
Attempting to join a room that doesn't exist should no longer cause the game to get stuck on a loading screen
Fixed an issue where the Aeronautics Badge could be acquired by someone else in your lobby performing its requirements.
The Daredevil Badge unlock requirement should now work properly.
Fixed weight not being updated when placing an item into a backpack that is on the ground.
Fixed being able to start climbing when being carried by a condor and teleporting you back to the wall once the condor releases you.

The Play Dead emote now locks you from item switching for its duration, preventing an exploit where players could drop from heights and receive no fall damage if they swapped items rapidly in this state.
Fixed an issue where lava flows would give you stamina when hitting you, which would let you exploit them for extended climbs with items that grant invincibility.
Fixed an issue where other players taking poison damage would not cause them to flash purple.
Localization and text UI improvement pass throughout the game.
Reduced the intensity of the snowstorm effect in Photosensitive Mode.
The crosshair for the Rescue Claw will now turn yellow when hovering over a player as opposed to terrain.
The title screen is back to the beach, this is how it's gonna look FOREVER.
Enjoy!

PREPARING FOR PORTS

Believe it or not, we’ve actually been putting in a lot of work behind the scenes to prepare the game for console ports! In this patch, we’ve merged in the porting work with the main Steam version of the game. This may introduce bugs or cause installed mods to stop working, but we wanted to get these issues out of the way before we actually launch on consoles. But on the bright side, we now have:
PEAK has room codes!!! This is how players will be able to play cross-platform once our console ports are out.
In a lobby, you should see a room code on the pause menu that can be copied and sent to your friends.
They can enter that code by hitting “JOIN GAME” on the main menu.
Existing ways to invite your friends to games will still work.
In the Settings menu, there is an option to hide the room code (for streamers)
Fanny Pack is now disabled in solo play.
You can no longer duplicate a Scout Effigy with Scout’s Generosity (for real this time)
Using the Rescue Claw on a friend will ragdoll them for less time, making it easier for them to grab onto something once the claw completes.
The max velocity you can get from bouncing off a mushroom from high up has been raised. This should make it more consistent to get the Mycoacrobatics Badge.
Jump height will decay slightly faster on consecutive bounces.
Bouncing onto a mushroom from higher up will now make it less likely for you to bounce at an unpredictable off-angle that could lead to taking fall damage.
Dislodging stuck-in arrows will no longer take priority over interacting with other things you might be looking at
Fixed “evil bounce mushrooms” having the same coloring as normal ones in the mushroom hell variant of ROOTS.
Fixed cooking a Rescue Claw leading to unintended behavior.
Fixed Frogs not turning into Frog Legs when getting cooked by environmental situations such as explosions.
Fixed an issue introduced in the last patch where Pandora’s Lunchbox would only inflict one type of status.
Fixed a case where the host's dropped items would sometimes disappear if they disconnected
Rapidly dropping/picking up items in a laggy lobby should no longer have a chance of deleting the item
Spike traps that have had terrain generate on top of them will not trigger.
Fixed a case where your "Peaks Summitted" stat would get incremented several times when winning, instead of just once
There is now a HUD indicator for when you are muted when using PUSH TO TALK/PUSH TO MUTE settings.
Your campfire save will now remember all the items you've got around the campfire instead of just what you're carrying on you
Citadel's TowerStacker code is no longer obfuscated

Reduced number of Clown Luggages needed to complete the Jester Achievement from 3 -> 2. May rework this achievement entirely later.

In the last patch we introduced a nerf to ropes by making it cost stamina to start grabbing them based on your distance from the rope. Since exploiting that lack of stamina cost is mostly a speedrunner technique and otherwise doesn’t affect gameplay much, we’ve reverted this change. Go nuts!

Max Tongue Angle 16°->14°
Cooldown 10s->12s
Pandora’s Lunchbox can now add some Curse to you sometimes. Use at your own risk…
Pandora’s Lunchbox will ignore Invincibility when adding statuses to you. It was just a bit too good, sorry!!
Cooking the Book of Bones will no longer provide any benefit.
FIXES
Improved map generation to prevent Amulet statues spawning inside of rocks and making the Amulet unobtainable.
Basic scout hats and berets should now be properly textured to match new costumes.
The Scout’s Generosity amulet can no longer clone Scout Effigy. As a note, the Checkpoint Flag and other Amulets are also not cloneable.
Color Blindness Mode will now make the Arrow Shooter “laser“ more visible for those with red-green color blindness.

Fixed the sprite that appears when unlocking the sash after completing Ascent 8.
Fixed a localization issue where Traditional Chinese text would display in Simplified Chinese.
Fixed the Bing Bong Airlines logo appearing backwards on the helicopter :)
Thickened the colliders on wrought-iron fences to reduce the likelihood of the player ragdoll getting stuck in them.
Fixed another scenario where the checkpoint flag could leave scouts in a broken state on another player’s screen.
Looker rocks should once again match the biome they’re in
Fixed an issue where cloning the jetpack with Scout’s Generosity created a jetpack with maximum fuel.
The Glider no longer gives forward momentum when ragdolled, such as when using the Play Dead emote.
Fixed the Glider’s networking so the positions of players using it are synced properly.
The glider now rotates forward in your hands when out of stamina as a visual indicator of its power being disabled.
The Glider now protects you from the sun’s heat in MESA.
Big Ghosts will now avoid spawning directly underneath players better.
Fixed an issue where Big Ghosts could sometimes spawn slightly too high underground, giving you less time to react to them after they spawned.
Okay! That's all for now. We're still keeping an eye out so let us know if anything else breaks in the meantime (But like, hopefully not)
The Peak Team
Hello Scouts! Thank you all for your feedback and bug reports for The Final Ascent. We wanted to get this quick patch out before the weekend, and yes, we nerfed the Frogs a bit!
Frogs now have a global cooldown where no other frog can grab you if you’ve recently been grabbed.

Nerfed Infinite Stamina across the board (specifically to target Bugle of Friendship). Gaining an infinite stamina buff will no longer immediately set your stamina to max. It will still prevent stamina from reducing and allow it to begin to regenerate like normal even while doing stamina-using actions like climbing. It will also let you do stamina-using actions even while your bar is visibly depleted. We know some people really like using the Bugle in its current state, but we feel that it’s just too good compared to basically all other Mystical items when you understand how to use the mechanics efficiently.
Fixed issue where players would stay muffled after dying to a flytrap
Fixed an issue where the Ritual Dagger could be used indefinitely.
Fixed an issue where killing a player who had placed a Checkpoint Flag with the Ritual Dagger could break their voice chat and mess up their character animations.
Fixed an issue with the collision of the backpack-shaped rock in \[REDACTED].
Fixed an issue where the level generation in \[REDACTED] could soft-lock a run by placing a rock in the wrong place.
Improved level generation in THE CITADEL to prevent floating obstacles.
Picking up an Amulet (Scout’s Ambition, etc.) now properly awards the Esoterica Badge.
Skeleton Scouts are now affected by spiders, flytraps, and arrow traps. (Be especially careful around the arrow traps…)
Capped how far forward the Big Ghost can spawn in GLOOM, to prevent it from appearing inside the stairs to the Citadel and ambushing you from below.
Glider no longer ignores custom run and ascent level’s stamina usage modification.
Portable stove cooking time restored to 60 seconds. Oops!
Fixed an issue where you could be stuck with permanent anti-gravity if you exited an anti-gravity sphere in specific ways.
Fixed an issue where scouts would sometimes not get achievements for completing biomes after loading an auto-save or reconnecting to an ongoing game.

items.text: Duck and cover, scouts! Major update coming your way with a lot of long-requested quality of life features … but we snuck in some weirder stuff, too.
The trailer explains all.

You can now modify all sorts of things about your run, such as individual difficulty settings, the presence of certain gameplay hazards, which items spawn in luggage… and more! Explore this menu at the Boarding Kiosk in the Airport. There are a few fun surprises for you, and more to come!
(Note: Achievements are disabled while using the Custom Run feature)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/14e43286b2d6c2a592839176f176e126318e4ddb.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/30db69834b5c08c26cef0fdea36385a092733318.png"]
As part of the Custom Run menu, we’ve introduced Mini Runs that let you play a single biome of today’s map. If you haven’t got time for a full run in the evenings, this mode is for you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/aa6450ee3442e498630c5c0f03ff46c5ef84fbd9.png"]

Our top scientists have been hard at work figuring out how to let you continue from your most recent campfire. And we’re pleased to report we’ve finally cracked the code. You can now leave an expedition and continue it later! The campfire autosave lasts until you win, lose, or start a new expedition.
(Note: If the game updates and we remove the map you were playing on, your save is gonna get erased. Sorry! Use it or lose it!)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/5339fbdab4b000922711d5c9a0923ed76ea0ae6a.png"]
You can now hang out as long as you like by a campfire without gaining hunger or the fog progressing. It will not extinguish until any scout leaves.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/1584d269aa04dc337ff43fcf9bf79d52dbb7864c.png"]

Everyone likes zombies… okay, maybe most people hate them. But some people really, really hate them. If you can’t stand the idea of your friend’s brain being taken over by mushrooms, we’ve introduced an alternative aesthetic for the mushroom enemies in the Roots that hopefully squicks you out less. As always, we’re very open to feedback on these sorts of accessibility options!
(Note: Zombies can also be removed entirely in the new Custom Run settings, or, as always, by playing in Tenderfoot difficulty.)

‼️ Okay, so this is pretty embarrassing. Turns out, gamepad sensitivity has been dependent on user framerate since we originally launched the game. (Remember how this was a game jam...?) That's fixed now, but because of that, If you play on gamepad, there's a good chance your look sensitivity will have changed when you next open the game and you'll need to tweak it a bit.

The Emote wheel can no longer be accessed as a ghost.
Fixed an issue where you would take increased fall damage if your wind walking from a Shroomberry expired while in midair.
Dynamite explosions slightly more optimized.
Added a failsafe to ropes being destroyed while they were being climbed (in rare situations).
OTHER THINGS
PlayerHandler.OnCharacterRegistered event re-instated (modders will know what this means)
Hey scouts! Another round of small changes and fixes. We're continuing to look at feedback and bug reports for the ROOTS update so keep it coming and have a fantastic, zombie-filled weekend!

Zombies will now recalculate their aggro target and begin chasing the closest player every ~10 seconds.

Fixed missing root collision on redwood stumps.

Player-specific audio sliders will now properly save their settings after a player disconnects and reconnects.
Fixed an issue where a player's zombie could bite you on the first frame they turned into a zombie.,
Re-allowed the Scout Cannon Glitch but only with the backpack.

Look, let's talk about this. We removed the glitch and you know why? It was never really a glitch. Cannons are supposed to shoot items with a force of 30. For some reason we typed in 5000 instead. It was literally just shooting them at Mach 10 for no reason. As a game developer it would hurt me not to just fix that. But hey we're reasonable. We know you want to skip the whole level for some reason. Great. This is our compromise. Only the backpack will still shoot with a velocity of 5000. Let's never speak of this again.

Fixed a typo in the description of Applied Esoterica Badge.
Fixed Mandrake scream volume not being affected by the SFX slider,
Fixed rare cases where the Mandrake wouldn't stop screaming even when far away.
Fixed an issue where the extra stamina bar wouldn't update if you only had a sliver of extra stamina remaining
ALRIGHT, what a day. Hope you've been enjoying the ROOTS!

We want them to feel properly terrifying for, well, a zombie, but they're clearly feeling like too much of a constant run-ender in the area and deserve to be nerfed a bit and show up significantly less often.

Happy climbing!
NEW GRAPHICS SETTING: Texture Quality

NEW GRAPHICS API: DX11

items.text: Glad you guys are enjoying eating each-other! Admittedly, it's a BIT much so now that you've all had your fun we're introducing some changes to cannibalism to just make it a little less crazy.

By turning it off, you will no longer see other players become chickens or be able to eat them, and other players will not be allowed to see you as a chicken or eat you.
BALANCE

items.text: Hey scouts! Thanks to everyone who's helped with the beta branch! We're so back with this new patch. As usual, continue to report any bugs through forums or our Discord <3
Most importantly we've improved the stability of the reconnecting to games if you get disconnected. There's some other goodies in here too :)
Oh and new languages should be arriving SOON.
Dramatically improved the stability of being able to reconnect to games after disconnecting.

Fixed a bug where spamming the climb button when out of stamina kills you instantly. You now can't spam frequently enough to stay in place. Blame the Caseoh stream for getting me to actually fix this.
Added a potential fix for the rare issue where backpacks disappear when dropped. Please reach out if you still experience this after this patch!
Fixed an issue where the Max Framerate setting wouldn't work.
Fixed an issue where Invert X is displayed as Invert Y in the Settings
Fixed an issue where the Passport wouldn't properly update your cosmetics when returning to the airport after a win.
Fixed bug where switching scenes didn't apply voice volume slider settings correctly
Fixed Bing Bong Badge being referred to as Volcanology on the Accolades menu.
Fixed an issue where scrolls wouldn't spawn properly at campsites, preventing players from more easily getting the Bookworm badge.
Fixed visual issues over the network when climbing on vines and chains.
Items can no longer be swapped or dropped while in the process of using them.
Fixed an issue where a variety of effects (such as infinite stamina from the Lollipop) wouldn't trigger if you were carrying an unconscious scout
Fixed Push To Talk disables itself on every loading screen
Removed a weird thin green line in the airport
Fixed an issue where eating a lollipop after using a heat pack would cause a ton of cold damage over time
Fixed an issue where certain items would remain suspended in the air when dropped from your inventory when you passed out.
Fixed an issue where the rope anchor preview would spawn on walls at weird angles
Fixed an issue causing Mentorship badge to sometimes not be awarded.
Fixed an issue where scrolls wouldnt spawn properly at campsites, preventing players from getting the Bookworm badge
You now only need a majority of players (instead of all) to hit "Next" at the end screen to continue in lobbies of 3 or more.
Select on controller can now be pressed to push-to-talk
The end screen will no longer break hopefully in modded lobbies of greater than 4 players. Hi modders<3
Your character will now point when pinging a location :)
Can now "select" a carried player (on controller only) and then press Interact to drop them

PS: thanks to everyone who reached out about the EULA. Some parts of the EULA were included in error. We've removed it entirely for now until we can come back with a version that properly represents the game. Among other things, we don't have any issue with sharing video content, including modded stuff, and most certainly have no plans to add any anti-cheat DRM to the game. Super sorry for all the confusion!!!!

items.text: Hello Scouts! Small bug fix today, but ideally this will help user reports of random players joining your game - sorry about that!

Through default Steam settings, players can join your game by searching your Steam username and joining if you do not have the correct privacy settings enabled. For extra protection on how to do this:
Go to "View My Profile" > Edit Profile > Privacy Settings > Change to Friends Only (or Private).
We have pushed a fix to hopefully prevent players from bypassing this but please let us know if you still encounter problems!
Lobby joining improvements Improved running/idle animations on sloped surfaces
Fixed issue causing Bookworm achievement to be unobtainable
Items that clear all statuses will no longer clear the Weight status
Cursed Skull now gives all your friends some bonus stamina, alongside its... other effects
We're continuing to bux fix larger problems too - including connection and performance issues. Thanks for your patience during this o7

notes.title: We’ve been tackling a bunch of bugs and responding to reports these past few days to allow as many players to peak as possible. We’ve just pushed another patch to address further issues that should help a variety of player reports!

items.text: Now, we’re gonna take a bit of a break to celebrate as a team and have a well-needed rest. Thank you for streaming our game, giving us feedback and taking your friends along with you. If you encounter any further bugs or issues, keep reporting in the Steam forums or through our email support@landfall.se .
Sweden’s celebrating Midsummer this weekend, so reports coming Fri-Sat will be replied to once we’ve taken some time to enjoy this launch as a team. Thank you again, this week truly was…peak

Added new items that spawn on the island: Shelf Fungus, Remedy Fungus, and Magic Bean.
Added Invert X and Y settings to the options menu.
Added better backend logging to help us continue to diagnose crashes and performance issues.
Reduced the intensity of the Poison screen effect to help photosensitive players.
Fixed an issue where Cure-All only worked on the third use.
Fixed issue where backpacks near the campfire could despawn when lighting the campfire.
Fixed issue where a cooked Egg wouldn't properly count towards the Gourmand badge, making that badge impossible (my apologies to those who found this out!!)
Cooked items will now show up as cooked in the backpack UI.
Fixed bug where you could carry many players at once under certain circumstances.
Fixed issue where push-to-talk could break when travelling to the island from the airport.
The bees' reign of terror is over. Significantly adjusted beehavior:
Poison damage and bee speed are much more reduced when NOT angry (ie the hive has been stolen/destroyed)
Bees will no longer continue stinging you when your status is already over 100%
Bees will tend to leave unconscious players behind and return to the hive instead of guarding their bodies forever.
Bees will forgive you faster if you drop the hive and leave them alone
Reduced bee speed and aggro distance by a bit generally.
Capped the max poison you receive from a Tick at 50%
Boosted mic volumes a bit by default.
The death timer will now speed up if you are in the fog if you’re unlikely to recover from your current injuries.
Lowered the Scout Statue in the Caldera temple.
Added new ambient SFX to the Tropics and the Peak.
PEAK will now ask you to pick your graphics API on startup. If you have experienced crashes or instability, we recommend switching from DX12 to Vulkan (or vice versa) as your first step to try.
Added a framerate cap to the settings menu. This should be your second step to try!
Fixed an issue where certain badges would show the wrong cosmetic being unlocked during the endgame screen
Fixed gamepad-only issue where pressing Sprint while climbing would not perform a lunge
Removed Warp Compass temporarily as it seems to send people to the void more often than not. Hopefully it comes back better than ever.
Prevented the Rope Shooter from firing and being wasted on a target that's out of range, like the Chain Shooter does
Fixed issue where guidebook pages on the ground could turn invisible
Prevented scouts from walking into the ocean
Increased the length of Energy Drink's buff, but reduced the amount it increases your speed. ALSO REDUCED THE DROWSY IT INFLICTS BY A LOT, SORRY TO ALL THE SCOUTS WHO LOST THEIR LIVES TO THIS ITEM
Both Lollipop and Energy Drink now have a "grace period" where they won't start their effect cooldown for a few seconds unless you begin climbing a wall
Brought in item rarities slightly so you'll see rarer items a bit more, and the most common ones will be less over-represented
Made the bombshrooms in the Tropics even more dangerous
Made jellyfish even harder to see
Morale Boosts no longer scale with number of nearby scouts
Made the Scoutmaster's Bugle even more terrifying
Cursed Skull and Scout Effigy will no longer spawn when playing solo
Cursed Skull will no longer spawn from Scout Statues (but can still spawn from Ancient Luggage)
Increased vine climb speed
Added "controls" page to the pause menu, letting you review the game's controls at any time
Added a message to spectators' UI to give a hint towards how to get revived
Added a unique reticle for when a projectile item has a valid target
Added UI for being boosted up from below by another scout
Guidebooks are now synced across clients, allowing your friends to read over your shoulder
Made the Scout Statue tower collider more accurate.
-The Landcrab Team
